title: fetch_document tool contract
description: Input and output contract for the fetch_document tool of the research agent. Read-only: the tool retrieves one document by identifier and performs no write.

document_id.description: Identifier returned by the search tool.

max_bytes.description: Upper bound on the returned body size, in bytes.

degraded.description: Output only. True when the body was truncated or the upstream timed out.
